description: Track the tool versions pinned in scripts/lib/versions.sh (see scripts/setup.sh), via a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment above each *_VERSION line.
Add go label to PRs which bumps go dependencies.
Group Go dependency patch updates in single PR.
Group CI dependency updates in single PR.
Group Dockerfile and docker-compose dependency updates in single PR.
Group Helm chart dependency updates in single PR, and patch-bump the version of every chart whose dependencies changed (see .agents/rules/quality/helm-chart-version-bump.md).
Group frontend (npm) dependency updates in single PR.

Hold typescript below 6 until openapi-typescript supports it (the lungo frontend uses openapi-typescript, whose latest release declares the peer range ^5.x, so typescript 6 makes npm fail with ERESOLVE). typescript 7 is also unsupported by typescript-eslint (peer range >=4.8.4 <6.1.0). Remove once both widen their peer ranges.

Hold the MUI packages below 8 until @open-ui-kit/core supports them (it pins @mui/icons-material ^7 and pulls @mui/lab 7, whose peer is @mui/material ^7.3.2, so MUI 9 makes npm fail with ERESOLVE). Remove once @open-ui-kit/core widens its peers.
Group updates to the pinned tool versions in scripts/lib/versions.sh in a single PR.

Regenerate the pinned archive checksums (scripts/lib/checksums.txt), the npm tools' lockfile (scripts/lib/npm-tools/package-lock.json), and, when NODE_VERSION or UV_VERSION changes, the image digests plus the Node literals task versions:check compares, once per branch. Each command must also be allowed by the host's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS (see .github/workflows/renovate.yaml).
Group Python (uv/pep621) dependency updates in single PR.
Always allow vulnerability/security fixes, even when other rules disable specific dependencies.

docker/Dockerfile.ui takes its Node tag from ARG NODE_VERSION (scripts/lib/versions.sh). The dockerfile manager substitutes an empty ARG and would rewrite the FROM line into a numeric tag. The digest is refreshed by scripts/tools/update_node_version.bash when NODE_VERSION changes. This rule is last so a vulnerability alert does not re-enable that rewrite.

docker/Dockerfile.python-agent takes its uv tag from ARG UV_VERSION (scripts/lib/versions.sh). The dockerfile manager substitutes an empty ARG and would rewrite that FROM line into a numeric tag. The digest is refreshed by scripts/tools/update_uv_image.bash when UV_VERSION changes. This rule matches the astral/uv package only, so the dir-ctl and dir-mcp FROM lines in the same file stay managed. This rule is last so a vulnerability alert does not re-enable that rewrite.
